title.zh: 修复横屏导师照片未显示并增加实时布局回归检查
title.en: Restore the selected tutor portrait on wide screens and add a runtime layout regression

purpose.zh: 修复上一版轮播中间照片因网格轨道收缩为零而消失的问题，并让 WebKit 在真实打开导师面板后测量照片。
purpose.en: Fix the previous carousel's center portrait disappearing when a grid track collapsed to zero, and make WebKit measure the portrait after opening the actual tutor panel.

zh: 复用已验证的中央照片尺寸，将轮播轨道改为弹性布局，照片保持完整比例与居中，两侧预览仍可切换。
WebKit 在打开真实导师面板后检查照片已加载、尺寸可用、未裁切且居中，防止类似漏检。
en: Reuse the verified central portrait sizing in a flex row so the complete selected image stays centered while adjacent previews remain selectable.
Open the real tutor panel in WebKit and assert that the loaded portrait has a usable size, remains uncropped, and is centered.

zh: 旗舰版实时导师照片和响应式验证；不改通话、导师偏好、账户或付款。
en: The Max live tutor portrait and responsive verification; no changes to calls, preferences, accounts, or payments.

zh: 修正中心照片轨道，避免 CSS 网格自动轨道宽度为零；保留原有轮播与通话锁定逻辑。
为已登录 WebKit 布局页加入开启导师面板步骤，并检查真实照片的宽度、比例和中心位置。
en: Correct the center portrait track so CSS grid auto sizing cannot collapse it, while preserving carousel selection and in-call locking.
Open the authenticated tutor panel in WebKit layout checks and measure the real image size, uncropped fit, and centering.

zh: 站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全套测试、构建与中英文 WebKit 响应式检查。
发布后实测桌面照片显示与侧边切换，核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, build, and Chinese/English responsive WebKit checks.
After deployment, inspect the wide selected portrait and side-preview switching, then verify the exact Project release record.

zh: 无付款、账户或实时语音行为变更。
en: No payment, account, or live-voice behavior changes.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的十三个界面语言、学习语言和现有导师照片。
en: Preserve SmartLingo's thirteen interface locales, learning-language selection, and existing tutor photos.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一部署提交；数据库无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the prior commit; no database change is involved.
